title: Let the two serializers remember the serial number respectively
goal: uses the returned internal function to save independent states.
summary: Two windows use one numberer respectively. When taking numbers alternately, each window only advances its own serial number.
tasks: completes makeTicketQueue(start) and returns a function that can be called repeatedly. Each time it returns the current number and adds one to the next time.
Two independently created numberers cannot affect each other. Keep the showTickets preview function in the starting code.

example.note: Internal functions can read and write local variables when they are created even if they are called externally. The example adds first and then returns. In this level, the current number is returned first.

hint: Create a separate ticket number variable inside each call to makeTicketQueue. Keep it out of global scope.
